R673.note: Allowlist validates sort column before f-string interpolation, raising on rejects; bound account_id/status params and default created_at sort preserved.

R674.note: Strict `^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$` allowlist blocks cmd.exe metacharacters, %, quotes, and leading-dash option injection before the ProcessBuilder sink; valid names unaffected.

R675.note: Switches to JNDI's 4-arg parameterized search ({0}/filterArgs, RFC4515-safe substitution); explicit `new SearchControls()` reproduces the same default scope as the original null argument.

R676.note: Parameterizes @Region via adapter.SelectCommand.Parameters.Add; DataTable name/columns and Fill() behavior unchanged.

R677.note: Adds an explicit caller.Role=="admin" gate before SuspendUser, fails closed with 403; no other behavior change.

R678.note: Removes the flagged LIBXML_NOENT flag (the entity-substitution cause); well-formed submissions without entities parse identically. LIBXML_NONET is a reasonable defense-in-depth add, though the explanation overstates it as blocking XXE generally since NONET only stops network fetches, not local file:// reads.

R679.note: Calls `userOwnsProject()`, which is never defined or imported anywhere in the shown files/write-up and has no backing ownership data model in projectStore.js; as written this throws a ReferenceError on every request before the sink is ever reached, silently breaking the endpoint for legitimate and malicious callers alike.

R680.note: Drops shell=True for an argv list and restricts filename to a safe charset (blocks traversal/metacharacters); leading-dash flag injection is moot since filename is embedded inside a fixed UPLOAD_DIR/ prefix.

R681.note: Flips the secure parameter to true; minimal, correct, nothing else changes.

R682.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode(ticketRef) closes the reflected-XSS sink; HtmlEncode(null) returns null so the missing-query-param case behaves as before.

R683.note: Allowlist shape is correct, but an unmatched field silently falls back to searching by 'name' instead of rejecting (disclosed plainly in the explanation, which caps this below 2); the whitelist's specific members also aren't derivable from the shown `SELECT *` query.

R684.note: Escapes the RFC4515 LDAP filter metacharacters (*()\ and NUL); ordinary alphanumeric usernames pass through unchanged.

R685.note: Standard `?` JdbcTemplate parameterization with orderNumber bound as an argument; query shape and row mapper unchanged.

R686.note: Replaces the cmd.exe ping invocation with the native System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping API, eliminating the shell entirely; response text format changes from multi-line ping.exe output to a single custom line, but this is disclosed as 'similar to' the original rather than an exact match.

R687.note: @PreAuthorize on the externally-invoked processMonthEndCleanup() is not subject to the self-invocation bypass, since MaintenanceController calls it through the injected (proxied) bean.

R688.note: Correctly eliminates exec() via an allowlisted operation-dispatch pattern, but this replaces the snippet-execution feature with an entirely new request schema (operation/parameters vs. code), breaking prior legitimate callers of the old payload shape -- disclosed openly, which is why this isn't a 0, but it is a stopped-legitimate-use change nonetheless.

R689.note: crypto/rand-based 128-bit hex token replaces predictable math/rand.Intn; username-token sessionID shape is preserved, cookie value is opaque to any caller.

R690.note: Reproduced against real Sequelize+sqlite: the `bind` option requires $1/$2-style placeholders, not `?`; the fixed query as written throws (SQLITE_RANGE: column index out of range) on every call, breaking the endpoint entirely for legitimate requests too, and this is not disclosed.

R691.note: Replaces the string built for setTimeout's implicit eval with a closure callback calling recordReminder(reminderId, message) directly, removing the code-injection sink with no observable behavior change.
